producer_attempts.definition: published implementation candidates, including the incomplete pre-VERIFY candidate

closure_producer_invocations.definition: one capacity-failed closure invocation and one successful closure invocation

implementation_elapsed_seconds.definition: sum of three producer invocation durations; excludes gaps and verification

repair_elapsed_seconds.definition: REJECT Issue-comment timestamp to repair-candidate Issue-comment timestamp

closure_elapsed_seconds.definition: ACCEPT Issue-comment timestamp to DONE Issue-comment timestamp; includes capacity failure and an otherwise unexplained gap
